sentences.text: Bench: Abhay S. Oka, Rajesh Bindal

1  IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA  CIVIL APPELLATE JURISDICTION  CIVIL APPEAL NO. 1131 of 2023  (Arising out of D. No.28825 of 2021  in SLP (C) No.3508 of 2023)
 DELHI ADMINISTRATION THROUGH SECRETARY LAND AND BUILDING DEPARTMENT  & ORS.
Appellant(s)

VERSUS  AZHAR AHMED & ANR. 
 O R D E R Heard the learned counsel appearing for the petitioners.
Notice was issued both on SLP and condonation of delay.
The first respondent who is the original writ petitioner has been duly served.
After having perused the impugned judgment and other material available on record, we are satisfied that in the facts of the case, the delay of 736 days deserves to be condoned.
Delay is condoned.
Leave granted.

By the impugned judgment, the High Court has granted relief in terms of Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013 (for short, the 2013 Act).

entities.text:
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The High Court has found that the compensation was not paid for the acquired land.

Therefore, the High Court relied upon a decision of this Court in the case of Pune Municipal Corporation and Anr. V. Harak Chand Misiri Mal Solanki & Ors. (2014) 3 SCC 183 and proceeded to hold that the acquisition has lapsed under Section 24(2) of the 2013 Act.

entities.text: Anr. V. Harak Chand Misiri Mal Solanki & Ors. (2014) 3 SCC 183
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for the appellants pointed out that in the writ petition filed by the first respondent, there is a specific averment in paragraph 3 that the possession of the acquired land was taken over.

In view of what is held in paragraph 366.3 of the decision of the Constitution Bench in the case of Indore Development Authority v. Manoharlal (2020) 2 SCC page 129, the High Court could not have granted a relief under Section 24(2) when possession of the acquired land was admittedly taken over.

entities.text: Indore Development Authority v. Manoharlal (2020) 2 SCC page 129
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Hence, the appeal is allowed.
